source_name: Compendex and Inspec through Engineering Village

normative_provenance.candidate_terminology_policy: S-C01 candidate terminology is non-normative and is absent from every draft cell.

paired_source_boundary.interface: normal rendered Expert Search plus normal same-origin RIS export only
paired_source_boundary.accounting_requirement: Preserve one paired event together with row-level Compendex/Inspec provenance and independently reconciled database totals. No separate total may be inferred from an unreconciled prefix.

field_scope.value: Unqualified Expert Search free-text query draft
field_scope.acceptance_gate: Do not call this title/abstract, All Fields, or same-field behavior until a successful live field-scope contrast and exact-query echo are recorded.

source_native_draft.term_rendering: Double-quoted literal terms; every finite dictionary spelling is retained explicitly.

acronym_boundary.value: double-quoted literal only; standalone-token behavior not established

stemming_expansion.value: not established; no morphology is collapsed

source_native_draft.source_parser_status: E01 did not reach a reconciled result page; syntax, phrase, punctuation, precedence, fields, and query-length support are untested.

paired_term_handling.normative_requirement: Unordered pair in one searchable field with at most five intervening lexical tokens.
paired_term_handling.draft_transport: Broader left-group AND right-group Boolean co-occurrence for every pair rule.
paired_term_handling.why_not_native_proximity: No successful source page was available to validate Engineering Village proximity syntax, unordered behavior, or its distance semantics.
paired_term_handling.future_gate: Replace only after a successful source-specific proximity validation or document a prospective broader same-field fallback that cannot lose exact pairs; never silently narrow/drop pair terms.

diagnostic_publication_date.upper_bound_label: pilot execution-date diagnostic upper bound only; P-001 remains unresolved and this is not a final common cutoff

source_deduplication.value: must be off for paired provenance unless current UI proves a separate non-destructive provenance route

compendex.reason: No successful source interaction reached thesaurus/indexed-term inspection.

inspec.reason: No successful source interaction reached thesaurus/indexed-term inspection.

controlled_vocabulary.mandatory_rule: Free text remains mandatory. Any later descriptor must be a tested OR supplement to its mapped free-text block; generic systems engineering alone cannot satisfy MBSE.

query_length_and_cell_policy.current_cells: One offline draft cell per partition; no semantic partition is silently split or narrowed.
query_length_and_cell_policy.future_split_rule: Only after a documented current source limit: prospectively map a lossless union of complete cells, preserve every cell query/total/identity ledger, and reconcile stable-ID union before accepting a partition.

lossless_union_rule.identity: Database-scoped Engineering Village accession only after nonempty uniqueness, row-level database provenance, RIS reconciliation, and stability are observed.
lossless_union_rule.failure: A source access, syntax, transport, pagination, export, provenance, identity, or completeness failure makes that cell/event total null and imports no prefix.

lossless_union.rationale: One offline draft cell preserves the complete dictionary Boolean tree; source parser, length, and execution validity remain untested.
